presentation.label: SEQ POS
presentation.summary: Exposes sequencer position as an LFO PMTR destination (SPOS) so LFOs can address which step plays.
presentation.overview: Seq Pos adds a per-audio-track sequencer position word that stock LFOs can write through PMTR = SPOS. When address mode is on, the tick plays the step selected by that word (scaled across the track length) instead of the stock playhead. Default off leaves stock sequencing unchanged until you set SPOS or point an LFO at it.
highlights: LFO SETUP: PMTR = SPOS (index 37) addresses the played step
Per-track address mode; default off = stock playhead
FUNC + TRACK + LEVEL sets SPOS 0–127 and enables; FUNC + TRACK + NO restores stock
ColdFire only: no DSP, no effect slot
usage: Hold FUNC + TRACK n and turn LEVEL to set that track’s addressed position (toast Tn SPOS nn).
In LFO SETUP set PMTR to SPOS and raise DEP so the LFO sweeps which step plays.
Hold FUNC + TRACK n and press NO to follow the stock playhead again.

access.location: FUNC + TRACK + LEVEL for SPOS; LFO SETUP → PMTR = SPOS for modulation
steps: Select an audio track with a pattern of distinct steps.
Hold FUNC and the TRACK key, turn LEVEL to set SPOS and enable address mode.
Hold FUNC and press LFO; set PMTR to SPOS and adjust DEP / WAVE / TRIG.
Hold FUNC + TRACK and press NO to return that track to the stock playhead.

controls.name: SPOS
controls.doc: Per-track sequencer position address 0–127, scaled across the track length when address mode is on. Edited with FUNC+TRACK+LEVEL; LFO PMTR SPOS writes the live word.

tutorial.title: Quick tutorial
steps: Include Seq Pos in a configuration (catalog-listed MOP-248). Put a pattern with distinct steps on an audio track (different locks or samples per step help).
Hold FUNC and the track’s TRACK key, turn LEVEL. The toast reads `Tn SPOS nn` and address mode turns on; you should hear the addressed step instead of the marching playhead.
Hold FUNC and press LFO. Set PMTR to SPOS, raise DEP, pick a WAVE. The LFO now sweeps which step plays. Hold FUNC + TRACK and press NO (`Tn SPOS OFF`) to follow the stock playhead again.
